📖 How to use

  1. Type your pattern and tick any flags.
  2. Paste or type the test string below.
  3. Matches highlight live with a running count.
  4. Inspect any match to see its capture groups.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which regex flavor is used?

JavaScript's RegExp engine — the same one used in browsers and Node.js.

Why do I see an error under the pattern?

The pattern failed to compile. The exact JavaScript error message is shown so you can fix it.

What do the flags mean?

g = global, i = case-insensitive, m = multiline (^/$ per line), s = dot matches newlines, u = unicode, y = sticky.
